goal: Prevent Tor peers from misclassifying as direct IP connections and inheriting whitelist permissions
Reject node startup when automatic Tor listening is enabled without a dedicated non-wildcard onion bind
agreement: Strong substantive support with no open objections (vasild, winterrdog)
Verified by testing on FreeBSD with Clang 19 (winterrdog)
Suggests redesigning the interface by replacing listenonion with an onionauto bind argument (vasild)
Concerns about breaking existing single-bind setups on upgrade answered as harsh but acceptable (sedited, vasild)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because incoming Tor peers through shared binds inherit local IP whitelist permissions
Fixes misclassification of onion traffic when automatic Tor listening is enabled with explicit bind args
